definition: cost_ratio = seconds per epoch on this cluster / seconds per epoch on the reference, same architecture, seed and schedule; gpu_hours_ref = gpu_hours / cost_ratio
note: ratio taken from the chengdu calibration on the same cluster and gpu unit; not measured again at expytky. On a whole H100 (trillium 1336478) c84e311c72 took 24.3 s per epoch against 23.4 s here, eb28991486 97 s against 160 s, 6f77e842fa 138 s against 264 s.
